question: The Konark Temple is situated in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Sun Temple of Konark is located in the town of Konark in the Puri district of the state of Orissa, India. Even after 750 years of its construction, the Sun Temple fails everyone with its uniqueness, vastness, and artistic grandeur.
 
• In fact, what we recognize as the Konark Sun Temple is the Jagmohan or Mahamandapa of the Sun Temple built on the side, which has been demolished long ago. Konark Sun Temple is also known as Black Pagoda in English.
 
• The Sun Temple was built by King Narasimha Dev I of the Ganga dynasty in about 1278 AD. It is said that this temple could not be built on the basis of its predetermined design.
 
• Its foundation was not built according to the heavy dome of the temple. According to the local people here, this dome was part of the temple, but due to its magnetic power, when the ship started crashing, then this dome was removed. Perhaps for this reason this temple is also called Black Pagod
